id: title:Gilbert09:strip nul bytes from warehouse column statistics

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion workflow: warehouse backend computes column statistics, converts bounds to strings, and writes to Postgres. NUL bytes are rejected by Postgres text fields, so this prevents ingestion failures or data corruption.
review.reason: The change P1.F1.H1 removes NUL bytes from warehouse column statistics before storing them in Postgres, preventing ingestion failures or data corruption. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement for warehouse ingestion. P1.F2.H1 is unassessed due to lack of established relationship or shared context, so it is excluded from scoring. No unverified outcomes are inferred.
